dealer noun

at cards

also card dealer

Renaissance

M-O s.v. card: dealer, from Vives 1540
Andresian p. 16
Traupman 301

distribūtor, distribūtōris m.

noun, third declension

Lewis & Short has it, in the general sense “distributer”, from Apuleius only (post-classical); Vives uses it of the dealer, with chartās distribuere, “deal” (see deal).

Other words

  • distribūtrīx, distribūtrīcis f. — dealer (a woman)

    noun, third declension · Renaissance · Andresian p. 16

    The feminine, in Jerome (Lewis & Short).

Examples

  • Ūnam habēs plūs jūstō.

    You’ve got one more than you should (to the dealer).Vīv. Exerc. 21

  • Miscē omnia, et rūrsum impertīre.

    Shuffle them all and deal again.Vīv. Exerc. 21

See also deal, shuffle, card game, playing card.
